={
  "model": "llama-3.1-8b-instant",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 500,
  "stream": false,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are a company size classifier. Return ONLY a single JSON object. No explanations. No reasoning. No extra text. No markdown."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are a strict information extraction system.

You must infer information from context even if it is not explicitly written.

Extract ONLY the following fields from the job title and description:

1. experience_level: choose ONLY one value from ["junior", "mid", "senior", "unknown"]
- Infer from responsibilities, seniority signals, years of experience hints, and role complexity.

2. skills: extract required skills or constraints.
-certifications: extract required or strictly recommended certifications
- If not explicitly listed, infer reasonable qualifications and skills based on the job role.
- Keep it short bullet-style in a single string.

INPUT:
Title: {{ JSON.stringify($json.title).slice(1, -1) }}
Description: {{ JSON.stringify($json.description).slice(1, -1) }}

OUTPUT RULES (VERY IMPORTANT):
- Return ONLY valid JSON
- Return EXACTLY these 3 keys:
  experience_level
  skills
-certifications
 No explanations
- No extra text
- No thinking
- No markdown

Example format:
{
  "experience_level": "mid",
  "skills": "- Skill 1\n- Skill 2"
}"
    }
  ]
}
